ERW (Electric Resistance Welded) Mild Steel Pipes are widely used in industrial, construction, and mechanical applications. These pipes are manufactured using the Electric Resistance Welding method, which involves passing an electric current through the edges of the pipe material to generate heat and weld them together. ERW Mild Steel Pipes are known for their high strength, cost-effectiveness, and versatility in various applications. These pipes are produced in compliance with industry standards, ensuring reliable performance in both low and high-pressure environments.
Manufacturing Process:
The ERW process begins with steel coils or plates, which are uncoiled, flattened, and passed through rollers.
The edges are then heated using electrical resistance and are brought together to form a seamless tube.
Once welded, the pipes undergo cooling, testing, and finishing processes, including surface cleaning and coating, to meet the required specifications.
Key Features:
High Strength & Durability:
 ERW pipes are designed to withstand high-pressure conditions and offer excellent structural integrity.
Corrosion Resistance:
 Available in galvanized or coated forms to prevent rust and corrosion.
Uniformity:
 Consistent wall thickness and precise diameter due to the advanced welding technology.
Lightweight yet Strong:
 Offers a good balance between strength and weight for easy handling and installation.
Versatility:
 Suitable for both domestic and industrial applications.
Applications:
Water & Gas Lines:
 Ideal for transportation of water, oil, and gas pipelines.
Structural Use:
 Widely used in construction for scaffolding, framework, and structural supports.
Transportation:
 For automotive exhaust systems, roll cages, and chassis components.
Fencing and Handrails:
 Frequently used in creating durable fences and barriers.
Agricultural Use:
 Employed in irrigation systems and farming equipment.
Industrial Infrastructure:
 Suitable for various mechanical and industrial uses.

Manufactured from low-carbon steel, they offer excellent weldability, machinability, and structural strength. These pipes are commonly used for water supply, plumbing, scaffolding, fencing, and fabrication work. Available in various shapes, sizes, and thicknesses, they can be easily customized for different requirements. Mild Steel Pipes provide a cost-effective solution with reliable performance and good load-bearing capacity. With proper coating or treatment, they also offer improved resistance to corrosion, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications across multiple industries.
